title: ulmus glabra subsp. scabra
intro: Ulmus glabra subsp. scabra, commonly known as the wavy-leaved elm, is a subspecies of the elm tree, characterized by its distinctive wavy-edged leaves. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus glabra subsp. scabra are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and demonstrate wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
